_doc: Drydock RO-9 tranche 4 witness (docs/governance/harbor-ro9-astral-toolchain.md § Ruled for tranche 4): every Ruff finding the tree carried on 2026-10-23, when [tool.ruff.lint] widened to select ALL with preview, less the standing exceptions pyproject.toml records. Ruled by the operator: a keyed shrink-ratchet baseline (verbatim: "b"), counted and run by gzkit ("Counted, gz-run (Rec.)"), in its own file ("Own file (Rec.)"). One row per POSIX path and rule, with its count, never by line. `gz lint` holds it exact: a finding no row holds, or one more than its row holds, fails; a row above its findings, and a row whose findings are gone, fail until `gz lint --ratchet` lowers or removes them. The ratchet never raises a row or adds one. Fix findings and ratchet in the same commit; baseline_count in data/waiver_ratchet_registry.json is the high-water mark the rows may only fall under.
